An AI assistant connected through Geister (Claude, ChatGPT, …) can now ask a member for power of attorney with a link. The member opens it, sees the assistant's name and principal, the permissions it asks for and until when, can untick permissions or make it end sooner, and clicks Authorize or Cancel. Requests expire after an hour and open only for the member they are addressed to; the link works inside the gos.earth portal too.

- The Power of attorney page now shows the permissions you can grant when you use the realm through the portal (it showed none before).
- The Grant and Authorize buttons are visible again.
